headline: Sparkling Hue Swap
title: Sparkling Hue Swap | Legendary Aniipod on Sparkling Aniimo | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Love your Sparkling Aniimo? The Sparkling Hue system just got an upgrade. Every hue you catch or roll is now unlocked for good, and Hue Swap lets you switch between them for Credits. Rerolling a hue you already own gives back two Sparkling Sigils. You can also use a Legendary Aniipod on a Sparkling Aniimo for its exclusive effect. Which hue is your favorite? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Sparkling Hue update: unlocked hues are permanent, Hue Swap costs Credits, duplicate rerolls return 2 Sparkling Sigils, and Legendary Aniipods work on Sparkling Aniimo.
